question: Rivet's arm and claw proportions: how far to cut the day's long arms? T2 measures arm:leg about 0.8 and a claw about a quarter of the leg; the day rig was 1.13. Body size stays 1.2 (slightly larger than a human). Frame labels: A/B/C left to right after T2.

options.label: T2 ratio: arms 0.72 length, claw 0.78, arms 0.8 thick (footprint 1.68 x 1.97 m)
options.tradeoff: matches the concept; the claw reads smaller at 32 px/m

options.label: Mild cut: arms 0.85, claw 0.9, arms 0.9 thick (1.72 x 2.01 m)
options.tradeoff: keeps more of the claw's punch at gameplay zoom, still longer than T2

options.label: Keep the day arms (1.90 x 2.05 m)
options.tradeoff: no change; the owner called these too large
